newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek C/A deficit down 16.2pct y/y in March - cbank.
newsitem.headline: Greek C/A deficit down 16.2pct y/y in March - cbank.

text.p: Greece's current account deficit fell a provisional 16.2 percent to $753 million in March from $898.5 million in the same month a year ago, the central bank said in a statement.
"The improvement is due to the large increase in the invisibles surplus by $217.6 million or 31.9 percent," it said.
The cumulative current account deficit was up 35.2 percent to $1.627 billion in the first quarter of this year compared to the same period last year, it said.
The trade deficit rose 4.6 percent year-on-year to $1.652 billion in March from $1.579 billion in the same month a year ago, it added.
Forex reserves were flat month-on-month at $16.3 billion at the end of June.
